description: Front Garden:T1: Chinese Privet - (left hand taller tree): Approximately 8.50m. Reduce crown back to previous and most recent points of reduction (approximately 1.20-1.40m).  Lightly thin crown density by up to 20%. Remove dead wood.T2: Chinese Privet - (right hand tree): Approximately 7.00m. Reduce crown back to previous and most recent reduction points (approximately 1.00-1.20m), preserving a suitable amount of secondary fine branch structure. Lightly thin crown density by up to 20%. Remove dead wood.T3: Judus Tree: Approximately 6.00m:  Reduce crown by approximately 0.80-1.00m providing sufficient clearance of the building. Thin crown density by up to 20%. Remove dead wood.Rear Garden:T4: Mature Bay - (left hand tree): Approximately 8.00m. Reduce back to previous reduction points, reducing crown height by approximately 1.50-2.00m.  Reduce lateral and sublateral growth to up to 1.00m.T5: Bay: Approximately 8.00m. Reduce back to previous reduction points, reducing crown height by approximately 1.50m. Reduce lateral and sublateral growth by up to 1.00m.Left Hand Boundary:T6: Small Chinese Privet: Approximately 5.00m. Tip prune by up to 0.70m to reduce and shape.Reasons for all:General maintenance/Control encroachment.
